name: Leh Palace
description: A 17th-century royal palace offering panoramic views of Leh and showcasing Tibetan architecture and artifacts.

name: Shanti Stupa
description: A white-domed Buddhist stupa on a hilltop providing spectacular sunrise and sunset views over Leh.

name: Hemis Monastery
description: The largest and wealthiest monastery in Ladakh, famous for its annual Hemis festival and intricate murals.

name: Nubra Valley
description: A stunning valley with sand dunes, double-humped Bactrian camels, and ancient monasteries nestled between mountains.

name: Pangong Lake
description: A breathtaking high-altitude lake famous for its changing hues and serene surroundings, straddling India and China.

name: Magnetic Hill
description: A gravity-defying slope where vehicles appear to roll uphill, a quirky natural optical illusion near Leh.

name: Spituk Monastery
description: A 11th-century Buddhist monastery perched on a hill offering peaceful ambiance and panoramic views of the Indus valley.

name: Stok Palace Museum
description: A royal museum displaying Ladakhi artifacts, traditional costumes, and the history of the Stok royal family.

name: Tsemo Gompa
description: An ancient monastery atop a hill with a golden statue of Maitreya Buddha and stunning views over Leh.

name: Chadar Trek (Frozen Zanskar River)
description: A thrilling winter trek over the frozen Zanskar River offering unique icy landscapes and local nomadic culture.

name: Hall of Fame Museum
description: A museum dedicated to the Indian Army’s history in Ladakh, showcasing military artifacts and stories of valor.

name: Suru Valley
description: A lush green valley with rivers, waterfalls, and traditional villages, perfect for nature lovers and trekkers.

name: Alchi Monastery
description: One of the oldest monasteries in Ladakh, renowned for its exquisite 11th-century wall paintings and sculptures.

name: Stok Kangri Trek
description: A challenging high-altitude trek to the summit of Stok Kangri peak, offering breathtaking Himalayan vistas.

name: Phyang Monastery
description: A peaceful 16th-century monastery known for its beautiful murals and annual Phyang Tsedup festival.

name: Tso Moriri Lake
description: A remote high-altitude lake surrounded by snow-capped mountains, home to migratory birds and nomadic herders.

name: Choglamsar Village
description: A traditional Ladakhi village offering authentic local experiences, handicrafts, and homestays.

name: Zanskar Valley
description: A remote and rugged valley known for its dramatic landscapes, ancient monasteries, and adventurous treks.

name: Basgo Monastery
description: An ancient monastery and fortress offering insight into Ladakh’s history and stunning views of the Indus River.

name: Sangam Point
description: The confluence of the Indus and Zanskar rivers, a serene spot perfect for photography and nature walks.
